what_worked: Power-law framing (39× gap) is a genuine insight that anchors the narrative coherently throughout.
fix_next: Total revenue is $15.6M not $13.5M; the pie chart percentages don't match the text claims; fix core numbers before building a thesis.
verdict: Confident VC tone built on several wrong numbers and too much decorative filler.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: Total MRR stated as $13.5M; actual 30-day revenue is $15.6M (and MRR ≠ revenue). Slide 4: Pie chart shows US at 73.05% but text says 63%—internally contradictory; $9.84M/15.6M ≈ 63%, so the pie is wrong. Slide 4: Title says '26% of Startups' but 258/1000=25.8% among all, and 258 is 25.8% not 26% (minor). Slide 9: Provider shares shown as percentages of only 5 providers (sum ~100%) but presented as if they are the full market; Paddle (16 companies) and Superwall (17) are omitted, making the pie misleading. Slide 8: Claims B2B achieves 'consistently higher revenue-per-customer' without showing any supporting data from the dataset; the actual median multiples (B2B 2.35× vs B2C 2.30×) are nearly identical.

evidence.insight: Slide 3's mean/median gap observation is genuinely useful; slide 7's revenue-per-visitor calculation adds value. But slides 10-14 repeat the same thesis without new data, and 'valuation multiples' discussion on slide 10 references no actual multiples from the dataset.
evidence.narrative: There is a clear through-line: power law → geography → category → monetization → thesis. The arc is coherent but the last four slides (11-14) are repetitive summaries that add no new evidence, padding the deck.
evidence.framing: No mention of missingness (241 country, 274 category, 288 audience_type missing). Audience is implicitly VC investors but never stated. No limitations slide. 'Revenue-generating companies across all verticals' on slide 2 is misleading—216 have zero revenue.
evidence.accuracy: Slide 2 headline figure $13.5M is wrong (total 30-day revenue is $15.6M). Slide 4 pie chart (73.05% US) contradicts its own text (63%). Provider pie omits Paddle and Superwall. Slide 8 B2B claims are unsupported. Slide 6 SaaS MRR of $589K and Education $524K are unverifiable and may conflate MRR with revenue.
evidence.visual: Gamma template throughout with decorative AI-generated illustrations on 6 of 14 slides that add no information. Only 2 actual data charts (slides 3 and 6). Slide 8's abstract bubble diagram is decorative, not data-driven. Pie charts on slides 4 and 9 are functional but one is factually wrong. Heavy text density on slides 11-12.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive consulting-speak: 'brutal precision,' 'alpha,' 'quiet compounder,' 'The Efficiency Mandate,' 'Close it before the market does.' Decorative stock illustrations on slides 1, 5, 7, 10, 13 add nothing. Slides 11-14 are nearly interchangeable strategy summaries with no new data. Risk/mitigation grid on slide 12 is generic enough to fit any dataset.
